seed_ledger.name: Pointe Coupee Power Station
seed_ledger.reason: NEW_LATERAL. Entergy Louisiana told the Louisiana Public Service Commission that a new gas pipeline has to be built for the three Pointe Coupee units. Who builds it, the route and the length are not public. Sources checked: Entergy direct testimony in the Meta docket (says pipeline costs and arrangements exist); Louisiana PSC testimony (units sit near the Big Cajun site); intervenor testimony and discovery (asks if the new pipeline needs FERC approval under the Natural Gas Act, and says the cost is spread on a system average basis); a general web search for FERC filings and open seasons for Big Cajun (nothing found); the newest federal pipeline projects workbook (no Pointe Coupee lateral found); trade press and local news (no route named). The 20-year Energy Transfer supply agreement in the same record is tied to other units, not shown to serve this plant. Searches run: 14.
